name: Nene's School!
source:
How do you stop a school shooting in a small american town? Simple: you either try to befriend the resident Satan worshipper...or put your faith in the American education system. Either way, Nene’s got a pop quiz to ace — on the so-called ‘Day of Judgment,’ no less.  Mommy issues and suicidal ideation might slow her down, but she’ll ace that test, dammit! Or she’ll die trying.

[From the itchi.io description]
